language_specific.morphology: 설명하- + -였- + -어요 contracts to 설명했어요, the informal polite past form.

common.sentence: 지수는 민호에게 엄마가 늦는다고 전했어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 민호에게 ...-는다고 전하다: convey a message to Minho.
language_specific.morphology: 전하- + -였- + -어요 contracts to 전했어요, the informal polite past form.

common.sentence: 직원은 팀장에게 장비가 고장 났다고 보고했어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 팀장에게 ...-았다고 보고하다: report a situation to the team leader.
language_specific.morphology: 보고하- + -였- + -어요 contracts to 보고했어요, the informal polite past form.
language_specific.social_context: An employee reports an equipment fault to a team leader.

common.sentence: 민수는 자기가 실수했다고 인정했어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: ...-였다고 인정하다: acknowledge a proposition; 자기 refers to Minsu.
language_specific.morphology: 인정하- + -였- + -어요 contracts to 인정했어요, the informal polite past form.

common.sentence: 유나는 동생이 약속을 지킬 거라고 믿어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: ...-ㄹ 거라고 믿다: believe a proposition about the future.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 믿어요 [미더요]. The final ㄷ links to the vowel ending; 믿다 is regular.

common.sentence: 저는 이 자리가 조용하다고 생각해요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: ...-다고 생각하다: think that a proposition is true.
language_specific.morphology: 생각하- + -여요 contracts to 생각해요, the informal polite present form.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 생각해요 [생가캐요]. ㄱ combines with ㅎ as ㅋ.

common.sentence: 언니는 다음 달에 새 아파트에 입주한다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 입주하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 아파트에 입주하다: move into an apartment.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 입주 [입쭈]; ㅈ is pronounced tense after the final ㅂ.

common.sentence: 아버지는 올해 은퇴할 거라고 가족에게 말씀하셨어요.

language_specific.morphology: 은퇴하- + -ㄹ forms 은퇴할; 것이다 supplies the prospective meaning. 것이라고, with the copula 이 and quotation ending -라고, contracts to 거라고.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker honors their father when reporting his words.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 은퇴할 거라고 [은퇴할 꺼라고]. The prospective ending ㄹ makes the following ㄱ tense.

common.sentence: 수진은 병원에 복직했다고 친구에게 말했어요.
common.meaning: reports having returned to a job

language_specific.morphology: 복직하- + -였- + -다고 contracts to 복직했다고, a past declarative quotation.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 병원에 복직하다: return to a job at a hospital.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 복직했다고 [복찌캗따고]; ㅈ is tense after ㄱ, and ㄱ followed by ㅎ is aspirated.

common.sentence: 동생은 작은 회사에 취업했다고 알려 줬어요.

language_specific.morphology: 취업하- + -였- + -다고 contracts to 취업했다고, a past declarative quotation.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 회사에 취업하다: get a job at a company.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 취업했다고 [취어팯따고]. ㅂ combines with ㅎ as ㅍ; past ㅆ has the coda sound ㄷ before tense ㄸ.

common.sentence: 지민은 오후에 우리 팀에 합류한다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 합류하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 팀에 합류하다: join a team.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 합류 [함뉴]. The sequence ㅂ + ㄹ is realized as ㅁ + ㄴ.

common.sentence: 관리인은 공사 구역의 출입을 통제한다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 통제하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 출입을 통제하다: control entry and exit.

common.sentence: 도서관은 한 사람당 대출 권수를 제한한다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 제한하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 대출 권수를 제한하다: limit the number of books borrowed.

common.sentence: 학교는 교실에서 물을 마시기를 허용한다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 허용하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 물을 마시기를 허용하다: allow drinking water; -기를 marks the nominalized action as the object.

common.sentence: 민지는 평일에 커피를 마시지 않는다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 마시- + -지 않다 forms verbal negation; 않- + -는다고 gives the present verbal declarative quotation 않는다고.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 않는다고 [안는다고]; ㅎ is not pronounced before ㄴ.

common.sentence: 지수는 새 의자가 편하지 않다고 했어요.
common.meaning: reports that something is not comfortable

language_specific.morphology: 편하- + -지 않다 forms descriptive negation; 않- + -다고 gives the present adjectival declarative quotation 않다고.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 않다고 [안타고]; ㅎ combines with the following ㄷ to produce ㅌ.

common.sentence: 태수는 어제 그 영화를 보지 않았다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 보- + -지 않다 forms verbal negation; 않- + -았- + -다고 gives the past declarative quotation 않았다고.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 않았다고 [아낟따고]; ㅎ is not pronounced before the vowel, and the past ending makes the following ㄷ tense.

common.sentence: 유나는 내일 모임에 가지 않을 거라고 했어요.
common.meaning: reports that someone will not go

language_specific.morphology: 가- + -지 않다 forms verbal negation; 않- + -을 forms 않을. 것이라고, with the copula 이 and quotation ending -라고, contracts to 거라고.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 가지 않을 거라고 [가지 아늘 꺼라고]. ㅎ is not pronounced before the vowel, and the prospective ending ㄹ makes the following ㄱ tense.

common.sentence: 수영장은 안전을 위해 음식 반입을 금지한다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 금지하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 음식 반입을 금지하다: prohibit bringing food in.

common.sentence: 기차 회사는 운행을 중단했다고 공지했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 중단하- + -였- + -다고 contracts to 중단했다고, a past declarative quotation.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 운행을 중단하다: stop a transport service.

common.sentence: 수영장은 다음 주에 수업을 재개한다고 알렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 재개하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 수업을 재개하다: resume classes.

common.sentence: 경찰은 두 사람의 진술이 일치한다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 일치하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 진술이 일치하다: statements agree with each other.

common.sentence: 뉴스에서는 어젯밤 사고가 발생했다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 발생하- + -였- + -다고 contracts to 발생했다고, a past declarative quotation.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사고가 발생하다: an accident occurs.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 발생 [발쌩]; ㅅ is pronounced tense after ㄹ.

common.sentence: 민수는 주말마다 작은 카페를 운영한다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 운영하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 카페를 운영하다: run a café.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 운영 [우녕]; the ㄴ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 직원은 이 카드로 포인트를 적립한다고 설명했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 적립하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 포인트를 적립하다: accumulate reward points.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 적립한다고 [정니판다고]. ㄱ + ㄹ is realized as ㅇ + ㄴ, and ㅂ combines with ㅎ as ㅍ.

common.sentence: 가게 주인은 직접 만든 잼을 판매한다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 판매하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 잼을 판매하다: sell jam.

common.sentence: 동생은 학교 연극의 포스터를 제작했다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 제작하- + -였- + -다고 contracts to 제작했다고, a past declarative quotation.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 포스터를 제작하다: produce a poster.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 제작했다고 [제자캗따고]; ㄱ combines with ㅎ as ㅋ, and the past ending makes the following ㄷ tense.

common.sentence: 도서관은 여름 방학 봉사자를 모집한다고 알렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 모집하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 봉사자를 모집하다: recruit volunteers.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 모집한다고 [모지판다고]; ㅂ and ㅎ combine as ㅍ.

common.sentence: 심사위원은 참가자 세 명을 선발했다고 발표했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 선발하- + -였- + -다고 contracts to 선발했다고, a past declarative quotation.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 참가자를 선발하다: select participants.

common.sentence: 선생님은 제 글에 같은 표현이 반복된다고 지적했어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: ...-ㄴ다고 지적하다: point out a proposition, often a problem.
language_specific.morphology: 지적하- + -였- + -어요 contracts to 지적했어요, the informal polite past form.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 지적했어요 [지저캐써요]. ㄱ combines with ㅎ as ㅋ, and past ㅆ links as the onset of 써.

common.sentence: 민수는 자기가 범인이 아니라고 주장했어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: ...-라고 주장하다: assert a proposition; 자기 refers to Minsu.
language_specific.morphology: 주장하- + -였- + -어요 contracts to 주장했어요, the informal polite past form.

common.sentence: 지수는 그 소문이 사실이 아니라고 부인했어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 사실이 아니라고 부인하다: deny something by saying that it is not true.
language_specific.morphology: 부인하- + -였- + -어요 contracts to 부인했어요, the informal polite past form.

common.sentence: 코치는 충분한 휴식이 중요하다고 강조했어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: ...-다고 강조하다: emphasize a proposition.
language_specific.morphology: 강조하- + -였- + -어요 contracts to 강조했어요, the informal polite past form.

common.sentence: 택배 회사는 물건값을 보상할 거라고 했어요.
common.meaning: reports that someone will compensate for a loss

language_specific.morphology: 보상하- + -ㄹ forms 보상할; 것이다 supplies the prospective meaning. 것이라고, with the copula 이 and quotation ending -라고, contracts to 거라고.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 물건값을 보상하다: compensate for the value of an item.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 보상할 거라고 [보상할 꺼라고]. The prospective ending ㄹ makes the following ㄱ tense.

common.sentence: 팀장은 새 직원이 부족한 인력을 보완한다고 했어요.
common.meaning: reports making up for a shortage

language_specific.morphology: 보완하- + -ㄴ다고: the verb takes the present declarative quotation ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 부족한 인력을 보완하다: make up for a staffing shortage.

common.sentence: 회사는 회의 시간을 단축했다고 직원들에게 알렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 단축하- + -였- + -다고 contracts to 단축했다고, a past declarative quotation.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시간을 단축하다: shorten the time spent.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 단축했다고 [단추캗따고]; ㄱ combines with ㅎ as ㅋ, and the past ending makes the following ㄷ tense.

common.sentence: 유나는 자기 선택이 옳았다고 확신해요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: ...-았다고 확신하다: be convinced of a proposition; 자기 refers to Yuna.
language_specific.morphology: 확신하- + -여요 contracts to 확신해요, the informal polite present form.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 확신해요 [확씬해요]. ㅅ becomes tense after ㄱ; ㄱ remains a stop rather than becoming nasal.

common.sentence: 민호는 친구의 말이 농담이었다고 깨달았어요.

language_specific.morphology: 깨닫다 has ㄷ irregular conjugation: 깨닫- becomes 깨달- before -았어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: ...-이었다고 깨닫다: realize a proposition.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 깨달았어요 [깨다라써요]; ㄹ links to the following vowel, and ㅆ links into 어.

common.sentence: 엄마가 나에게 아침을 먹느냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 먹- + -느냐고: attach -느냐고 to the verb stem to report a present question.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 먹느냐고 [멍느냐고]: the final ㄱ assimilates to ㅇ before ㄴ.

common.sentence: 민수가 지수에게 어디에 가느냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 가- + -느냐고: attach -느냐고 to the verb stem; 어디에 supplies the question word.

common.sentence: 지수가 민수에게 서울에 사느냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 살- + -느냐고 → 사느냐고: the stem-final ㄹ drops before ㄴ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 장소에 살다: live in a place.

common.sentence: 선생님이 민수에게 무슨 책을 읽느냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 읽- + -느냐고: attach -느냐고 to the verb stem; 무슨 책 supplies the question phrase.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 읽느냐고 [잉느냐고]: the final ㄺ is realized as ㄱ, which assimilates to ㅇ before ㄴ.

common.sentence: 지수가 민수에게 새 가방이 크냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 크- + -냐고: attach -냐고 to the vowel-final adjective stem.

common.sentence: 아빠가 나에게 시험이 어려우냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 어렵- + -으냐고 → 어려우냐고: the irregular ㅂ changes to 우 before the vowel-initial ending.

common.sentence: 민수가 지수에게 방이 좁으냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 좁- + -으냐고: attach -으냐고 to the consonant-final adjective stem.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 좁으냐고 [조브냐고]: ㅂ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 지수가 민수에게 하늘이 왜 파라냐고 물었어요.
common.meaning: asks a question about being blue

language_specific.morphology: 파랗- + -으냐고 → 파라냐고: the ㅎ-irregular stem loses ㅎ, and the ending's 으 does not appear in the surface form.

common.sentence: 지수가 민수에게 그 사람이 학생이냐고 물었어요.
common.meaning: marks a reported question about identity

language_specific.morphology: 학생 + 이- + -냐고: the copula 이다 follows a consonant-final noun.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 학생이냐고 [학쌩이냐고]: ㄱ causes the following ㅅ to be tense.

common.sentence: 민수가 지수에게 저분이 의사냐고 물었어요.
common.meaning: marks a reported question about identity

language_specific.morphology: 의사 + 이- + -냐고 → 의사냐고: the copula 이- is omitted after a vowel-final noun.

common.sentence: 엄마가 나에게 전화한 사람이 누구냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 누구 + 이- + -냐고 → 누구냐고: the copula 이- is omitted after the vowel-final pronoun.

common.sentence: 민수가 지수에게 어느 책이 지수 것이냐고 물었어요.
common.meaning: marks a reported question about identity

language_specific.morphology: 것 + 이- + -냐고: the copula 이다 follows a consonant-final noun; 어느 책 supplies the question phrase.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 것이냐고 [거시냐고]: the final ㅅ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 민수가 지수에게 시간이 있느냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 있- + -느냐고: possessive 있다 is an adjective, but it takes -느냐고 in this present reported question.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 있느냐고 [인느냐고]. Final ㅆ has the coda sound ㄷ, which nasalizes to ㄴ before ㄴ.

common.sentence: 지수가 민수에게 왜 우산이 없느냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 없- + -느냐고: 없다 is an adjective, but it takes -느냐고 in this present reported question; 왜 supplies the question word.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 없느냐고 [엄느냐고]: the final cluster is realized as ㅂ, which assimilates to ㅁ before ㄴ.

common.sentence: 엄마가 나에게 왜 학교에 가지 않느냐고 물었어요.
common.meaning: asks a question about not going

language_specific.morphology: 가- + -지 않- + -느냐고: verbal negation 않다 takes the verbal present question ending.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 않느냐고 [안느냐고]: ㅎ is not pronounced before ㄴ.

common.sentence: 민수가 지수에게 그 사람이 선생님이 아니냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 아니- + -냐고: the negative copula takes the adjective question ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 명사이/가 아니다: not be the stated person or thing.

common.sentence: 민수가 담당자에게 오늘 접수가 불가능하냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 불가능하- + -냐고: the adjective takes the present reported-question ending.

common.sentence: 지수가 민수에게 무엇이 가장 소중하냐고 물었어요.
common.meaning: asks a question about being precious

language_specific.morphology: 소중하- + -냐고: the adjective takes the present reported-question ending.

common.sentence: 민수가 지수에게 결과가 궁금하냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 궁금하- + -냐고: the adjective takes the present reported-question ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 결과가 궁금하다: be curious about the result.

common.sentence: 아이가 아빠에게 마술이 신기하냐고 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 신기하- + -냐고: the adjective takes the present reported-question ending.

common.sentence: 민수가 지수에게 그 건물이 왜 독특하냐고 물었어요.
common.meaning: asks a question about being distinctive

language_specific.morphology: 독특하- + -냐고: the adjective takes the present reported-question ending.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 독특하냐고 [독트카냐고]: final ㄱ and following ㅎ produce ㅋ.

common.sentence: 선생님이 학생들을 운동장에 집합하게 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 집합하- + -게 하다 expresses causation; 하- + -였어요 contracts to 했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 학생들을 운동장에 집합하게 하다: make the students assemble on the playground.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '집합하게 했어요' [지파파게 해써요]. Each final ㅂ combines with the following ㅎ as [ㅍ].

common.sentence: 직원이 손님들을 입구에서 대기하게 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 대기하- + -게 하다 expresses causation; 하- + -였어요 contracts to 했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 손님들을 입구에서 대기하게 하다: make the guests wait at the entrance.

common.sentence: 직원이 관객들을 공연장 밖으로 퇴장하게 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 퇴장하- + -게 하다 expresses causation; 하- + -였어요 contracts to 했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 관객들을 공연장 밖으로 퇴장하게 하다: make the audience leave the venue.

common.sentence: 지휘관이 군인들을 강 뒤로 후퇴하게 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 후퇴하- + -게 하다 expresses causation; 하- + -였어요 contracts to 했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 군인들을 강 뒤로 후퇴하게 하다: make the soldiers retreat behind the river.

common.sentence: 지휘관이 군인들을 앞으로 전진하게 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 전진하- + -게 하다 expresses causation; 하- + -였어요 contracts to 했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 군인들을 앞으로 전진하게 하다: make the soldiers advance.

common.sentence: 경찰이 도로의 차량들을 정지하게 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 정지하- + -게 하다 expresses causation; 하- + -였어요 contracts to 했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 차량들을 정지하게 하다: bring the vehicles to a stop.

common.sentence: 신고를 받은 상황실이 소방차를 출동하게 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 출동하- + -게 하다 expresses causation; 하- + -였어요 contracts to 했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 소방차를 출동하게 하다: send a fire engine out in response.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '출동하게 했어요' [출똥하게 해써요]. The ㄷ in 출동 is pronounced tense after ㄹ.

common.sentence: 그 향기가 저에게 고향을 연상하게 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 연상하- + -게 하다 expresses causation; 하- + -였어요 contracts to 했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 저에게 고향을 연상하게 하다: make me think of my hometown.

common.sentence: 흥미로운 이야기가 아이들을 책에 몰입하게 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 몰입하- + -게 하다 expresses causation; 하- + -였어요 contracts to 했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 아이들을 책에 몰입하게 하다: make the children become absorbed in a book.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '몰입하게 했어요' [모리파게 해써요]. ㄹ links to the following vowel, and final ㅂ combines with ㅎ as [ㅍ].

common.sentence: 저는 선생님께 꽃을 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker gives flowers to a teacher.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람께 물건을 드리다: give something to an honored recipient; ordinary 주다 does not itself honor the recipient.

common.sentence: 저는 할머니를 병원까지 모셨어요.

language_specific.morphology: 모시+었어요 contracts to 모셨어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker accompanies their grandmother to the hospital.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 장소까지 모시다: accompany an honored person to a place; 데리다 is the ordinary counterpart.

common.sentence: 제가 선생님께 이유를 여쭙겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 여쭙- + -겠- + -습니다 → 여쭙겠습니다. The ㅂ-irregular stem retains ㅂ before consonant-initial -겠-; -겠- marks the speaker's intention.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker intends to ask a teacher.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람께 내용을 여쭙다: ask an honored person about something; 묻다 is the ordinary counterpart.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '여쭙겠습니다' [여쭙껟씀니다]. The ㄱ after ㅂ is tense, and 습니다 is pronounced [씀니다].

common.sentence: 저는 내일 선생님을 학교에서 뵙겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 뵙+겠+습니다 forms 뵙겠습니다, expressing a formal intention to meet.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker plans to meet a teacher.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 뵙다: meet or see an honored person; 보다 and 만나다 are ordinary alternatives.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '뵙겠습니다' [뵙껟씀니다/뷉껟씀니다]. The ㄱ after ㅂ is tense, and 습니다 is pronounced [씀니다].

common.sentence: 제가 선생님께 시간을 여쭤 봤어요.

language_specific.morphology: 여쭈+어 contracts to 여쭤, followed here by 봤어요. This form comes from 여쭈다, not the ㅂ-irregular 여쭙다.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asked a teacher about the time.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람께 내용을 여쭈어 보다: ask an honored person about something.

common.sentence: 저는 어제 선생님을 도서관에서 뵀어요.

language_specific.morphology: 뵈+었어요 contracts to 뵀어요. The vowel-ending form 뵈어 also contracts to 봬; 뵙겠습니다 is a form of 뵙다.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker met a teacher.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 뵈다: meet or see an honored person.

common.sentence: 선생님께서 할머니께 꽃을 드리셨어요.

language_specific.morphology: 드리+시+었어요 contracts to 드리셨어요; 시 honors the subject.
language_specific.social_context: The teacher gives flowers to the grandmother; both the giver and recipient are honored.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람께 물건을 드리시다: an honored person gives something to an honored recipient.

common.sentence: 제가 할머니를 병원까지 모셔 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 모시+어 becomes 모셔; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary 드리다 marks the action as a respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker accompanies their grandmother to the hospital for her benefit.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 장소까지 모셔 드리다: accompany an honored person to a destination.

common.sentence: 제가 선생님께 결과를 말씀드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 말씀드리+었어요 contracts to 말씀드렸어요; the nominal action suffix 드리다 is written together with 말씀.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker told a teacher the result.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람께 내용을 말씀드리다: respectfully tell someone something.

common.sentence: 저는 내일 선생님을 찾아뵙겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 찾아뵙+겠+습니다 forms 찾아뵙겠습니다, expressing a formal intention to visit an honored person.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker plans to visit a teacher.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 찾아뵙다: go to visit an honored person.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '찾아뵙겠습니다' [차자뵙껟씀니다/차자뷉껟씀니다]. The final ㅈ of 찾 links to 아; the ㄱ after ㅂ is tense, and 습니다 is pronounced [씀니다].

common.sentence: 제가 역에서 할머니를 이 집으로 모셔 왔어요.

language_specific.morphology: 모시+어 becomes 모셔; 오+았어요 contracts to 왔어요. The directional verbs are written separately.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker brought their grandmother from the station to this house, the reference location.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 이곳으로 모셔 오다: accompany an honored person toward the reference location.

common.sentence: 제가 이 집에서 할머니를 병원으로 모셔 갔어요.

language_specific.morphology: 모시+어 becomes 모셔; 가+았어요 contracts to 갔어요. The directional verbs are written separately.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker accompanied their grandmother from this house to the hospital.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 이곳에서 목적지로 모셔 가다: accompany an honored person away from the reference location.

common.sentence: 저는 전화로 할머니께 안부를 여쭈었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 안부를 is the object of 여쭈다; 여쭈+었어요 forms 여쭈었어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker called their grandmother and asked how she was.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람께 안부를 여쭈다: inquire respectfully after someone's well-being.

common.sentence: 저는 설에 할머니께 문안을 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 문안을 is the object of 드리다; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker paid respects to their grandmother on Lunar New Year.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람께 문안을 드리다: pay respectful greetings to someone.

common.sentence: 저는 실수에 대해 선생님께 사죄드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 사죄드리+었어요 contracts to 사죄드렸어요; the suffix 드리다 is attached to 사죄.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker apologized to a teacher for a mistake.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람께 일에 대해 사죄드리다: respectfully apologize to someone for something.

common.sentence: 저는 지각에 대해 선생님께 양해를 구했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 양해를 is the object of 구하다; 구하+였어요 contracts to 구했어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asked a teacher to understand their lateness.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람께 일에 대해 양해를 구하다: ask someone for understanding about something.

common.sentence: 저는 선생님의 선물을 정중히 사양했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 사양하+였어요 contracts to 사양했어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely declined a teacher's gift.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 선물을 사양하다: politely decline a gift.

common.sentence: 저는 평생 할머니를 공경했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 공경하+였어요 contracts to 공경했어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker describes their enduring respect for their grandmother.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 공경하다: hold a person, especially an elder, in deep respect.

common.sentence: 우리 학교는 그 선생님을 특별히 예우했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 예우하+였어요 contracts to 예우했어요.
language_specific.social_context: The school treated the teacher with special respect.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 예우하다: treat someone with appropriate respect and courtesy.

common.sentence: 저는 학생들을 아끼는 선생님을 존경해요.

language_specific.morphology: 존경하+여요 contracts to 존경해요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker admires a teacher who cares for students.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 존경하다: respect and admire a person.

common.sentence: 제가 역에서 선생님을 마중해 드렸어요.
common.meaning: went to meet an honored person

language_specific.morphology: 마중하- + -여 → 마중해; 드리- + -었어요 → 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker met the arriving teacher at the station.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 오는 사람을 마중해 드리다: go out to meet an honored person who is arriving.

common.sentence: 저는 선생님께 저녁을 대접했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 대접하+였어요 contracts to 대접했어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker treated a teacher to dinner.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람께 음식을 대접하다: offer someone food as a respectful treat.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '대접했어요' [대저패써요]. The ㅂ and following ㅎ produce an aspirated ㅍ, and the past ending is pronounced [써요].

common.sentence: 직원이 선생님의 전화에 응대해 드렸어요.
common.meaning: responded courteously for an honored person

language_specific.morphology: 응대하+여 becomes 응대해; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful service.
language_specific.social_context: An employee responds politely to a teacher's call; 드리다 treats the teacher as an honored beneficiary.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람의 전화에 응대해 드리다: respond courteously to an honored person's call; 드리다 marks respect toward the caller.

common.sentence: 회사는 방문한 선생님을 식사로 접대했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 접대하+였어요 contracts to 접대했어요.
language_specific.social_context: The company hosted a visiting teacher with a meal.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 손님을 식사로 접대하다: entertain a guest with a meal.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '접대했어요' [접때해써요]. The ㄷ after the 받침 is tense, and the past ending is pronounced [써요].

common.sentence: 저는 입원하신 선생님을 문병해 드렸어요.
common.meaning: visited an honored person who was ill

language_specific.morphology: 문병하- + -여 → 문병해; 드리- + -었어요 → 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker visited their hospitalized teacher.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 아픈 사람을 문병해 드리다: visit an honored person who is ill.

common.sentence: 제가 선생님의 편지를 한국어로 번역해 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 번역하+여 becomes 번역해; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker translated a letter into Korean for a teacher.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 글을 언어로 번역해 드리다: translate a text into a language for an honored person.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '번역해 드렸어요' [버녀캐 드려써요]. The ㄴ links to the following vowel and ㄱ combines with ㅎ as aspirated ㅋ.

common.sentence: 제가 할머니의 병원비를 대납해 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 대납하+여 becomes 대납해; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker paid their grandmother's hospital bill on her behalf.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람의 비용을 대납해 드리다: pay a cost on an honored person's behalf.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '대납해 드렸어요' [대나패 드려써요]. The ㅂ and following ㅎ combine as aspirated ㅍ.

common.sentence: 제가 선생님을 위해 학생들을 박물관으로 인솔해 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 인솔하+여 becomes 인솔해; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker led students to a museum for a teacher.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람들을 장소로 인솔해 드리다: lead a group to a place for an honored person.

common.sentence: 제가 선생님과 학생의 갈등을 중재해 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 중재하+여 becomes 중재해; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker mediated a conflict between a teacher and a student.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람들 사이의 갈등을 중재해 드리다: mediate a conflict for an honored person.

common.sentence: 제가 선생님과 학생의 만남을 주선해 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 주선하+여 becomes 주선해; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker arranged a meeting between a teacher and a student.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람들의 만남을 주선해 드리다: arrange a meeting for an honored person.

common.sentence: 저는 회의에서 선생님을 보좌했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 보좌하+였어요 contracts to 보좌했어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker assisted a teacher during a meeting.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 보좌하다: assist someone with their duties.

common.sentence: 제가 아프신 할머니를 보살펴 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 보살피+어 contracts to 보살펴; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker cared for their ill grandmother.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 보살펴 드리다: look after an honored person.

common.sentence: 간호사가 수술 후 할머니를 간호해 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 간호하+여 becomes 간호해; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: A nurse cared for the grandmother after surgery.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 환자를 간호해 드리다: provide nursing care to an honored patient.

common.sentence: 제가 입원하신 할머니를 밤새 간병해 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 간병하+여 becomes 간병해; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker attended to their hospitalized grandmother throughout the night.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 환자를 간병해 드리다: attend to an honored person's needs while they are ill.

common.sentence: 제가 계단에서 할머니를 부축해 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 부축하+여 becomes 부축해; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker physically supported their grandmother on the stairs.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 부축해 드리다: support an honored person physically as they move.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '부축해 드렸어요' [부추캐 드려써요]. The ㄱ and following ㅎ combine as aspirated ㅋ.

common.sentence: 제가 할머니의 편지를 대필해 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 대필하+여 becomes 대필해; 드리+었어요 contracts to 드렸어요. The spaced auxiliary marks respectful benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker wrote a letter on their grandmother's behalf.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람의 글을 대필해 드리다: write a text on an honored person's behalf.

common.sentence: 저는 집에서 할머니를 정성껏 섬겼어요.

language_specific.morphology: 섬기+었어요 contracts to 섬겼어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker served and cared for their grandmother at home.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람을 섬기다: serve a person with respect and care.

common.sentence: 저는 선생님의 은혜에 보답했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 보답하+였어요 contracts to 보답했어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker repaid a teacher's kindness.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 은혜에 보답하다: repay kindness or a favor.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '보답했어요' [보다패써요]. The ㅂ and following ㅎ combine as aspirated ㅍ.

common.sentence: 저는 선생님의 선물에 꽃으로 답례했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 답례하+였어요 contracts to 답례했어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker gave flowers in return for a teacher's gift.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 선물에 선물로 답례하다: return a gift with another gift as a courtesy.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '답례했어요' [담녜해써요]. The ㄹ after ㅂ is realized as ㄴ, and the preceding ㅂ assimilates to ㅁ.

common.sentence: 저자는 선생님께 새 책을 증정했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 증정하+였어요 contracts to 증정했어요.
