common.sentence: 팀장님, 각 팀에 예산을 배분해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 배분하- + 여 contracts to 배분해; 주- + 시 + 겠 + 어요 makes a polite request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks the team leader to allocate the budget among the teams.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 각 팀에 예산을 배분하다: allocate a budget to each team.

common.sentence: 직원님, 이 도서관에서 저에게 책을 대출해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 대출하- + 여 contracts to 대출해; 주- + 시 + 겠 + 어요 makes a polite request.
language_specific.social_context: The library user asks a staff member to lend them a book.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 저에게 책을 대출하다: lend me a book.

common.sentence: 고객님, 남은 참가비를 환급해 드렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 환급하- + 여 contracts to 환급해; 드리- + 었어요 contracts to 드렸어요, marking a past action for an honored beneficiary.
language_specific.social_context: A service provider tells the customer that the remaining participation fee has been reimbursed.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 참가비를 환급하다: reimburse a participation fee.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 환급해 [환그패]; the final ㅂ combines with ㅎ to produce ㅍ.

common.sentence: 선생님, 제가 쓴 글을 교정해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 교정하- + 여 contracts to 교정해; 주- + 시 + 겠 + 어요 makes a polite request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks the person addressed as 선생님 to correct a piece of writing.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 글을 교정하다: proofread and correct a text.

common.sentence: 회원님, 이번 달 회비를 납입해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 납입하- + 여 contracts to 납입해; 주- + 시 + 겠 + 어요 makes a polite request.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 납입해 [나비패]; the final consonant of 납 links to 입, and ㅂ and ㅎ combine as ㅍ.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks a member to pay this month's membership fee.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 회비를 납입하다: pay in a membership fee.

common.sentence: 담당자님, 도착한 물품을 검수해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 검수하- + 여 contracts to 검수해; 주- + 시 + 겠 + 어요 makes a polite request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks the person in charge to inspect the goods that arrived.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 물품을 검수하다: inspect goods upon receipt.

common.sentence: 심사위원님, 이 작품을 심사해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 심사하- + 여 contracts to 심사해; 주- + 시 + 겠 + 어요 makes a polite request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks a judge to evaluate a work.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 작품을 심사하다: evaluate a work as a judge.

common.sentence: 연구원님, 이 실험 결과를 검증해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 검증하- + 여 contracts to 검증해; 주- + 시 + 겠 + 어요 makes a polite request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks a researcher to verify an experimental result.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 실험 결과를 검증하다: verify an experimental result.

common.sentence: 직원님, 제 신분증으로 제 신원을 인증해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 인증하- + 여 contracts to 인증해; 주- + 시 + 겠 + 어요 makes a polite request.
language_specific.social_context: The customer asks a staff member to verify their identity using their ID.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 신분증으로 신원을 인증하다: verify identity using an ID.

common.sentence: 선생님, 이 공식을 증명해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 증명하- + 여 contracts to 증명해; 주- + 시 + 겠 + 어요 makes a polite request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks the person addressed as 선생님 to prove a formula.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 공식을 증명하다: prove a formula.

common.sentence: 민수 씨, 점심 식사했어요? 네, 먹었어요.
common.note: The reply omits its subject; the question identifies the addressee as the person answering.

common.sentence: 지수는 집에 왔어요. 곧 잠들었어요.
common.note: The second sentence omits its subject and continues with 지수 as the actor.

language_specific.morphology: 잠들었어요 = 잠들- + -었어요, the past polite form of 잠들다.

common.sentence: 제가 편지를 받았어요. 바로 읽었어요.
common.note: The second sentence omits both the speaker as subject and 편지 as object.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 읽었어요 [일거써요]. The ㄺ cluster is split before the vowel, and ㅆ remains tense.

common.sentence: 민수는 차를 마셨어요. 지수는 물을 마셨어요.
common.note: The new topic identifies who drank water rather than continuing with 민수.

language_specific.morphology: 지수는 = 지수 + 는, the topic particle after a vowel.

common.sentence: 민수가 절구에 마늘을 넣고 빻았어요.
common.note: The subject and object of the second action are recoverable as 민수 and 마늘.

language_specific.morphology: 빻았어요 = 빻- + -았어요, the past polite form of 빻다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 빻았어요 [빠아써요]. The ㅎ is not pronounced between vowels.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 마늘을 절구에 넣고 빻다: pound garlic in a mortar.

common.sentence: 지수가 감자를 삶고 포크로 으깼어요.
common.note: 지수 remains the actor and 감자 is the omitted object.

language_specific.morphology: 으깼어요 = 으깨- + -었어요, contracted from 으깨었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 감자를 포크로 으깨다: mash a potato with a fork.

common.sentence: 제가 원두를 샀어요. 분쇄기로 갈았어요.
common.note: The speaker and the coffee beans remain the understood subject and object.

language_specific.morphology: 갈았어요 = 갈- + -았어요, the past polite form of 갈다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 원두를 분쇄기로 갈다: grind coffee beans in a grinder.

common.sentence: 자전거를 밖에 뒀어요. 비를 맞아 녹슬었어요.
common.note: The bicycle is the understood subject of the second sentence.

language_specific.morphology: 녹슬었어요 = 녹슬- + -었어요, the past polite form of 녹슬다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 녹슬었어요 [녹쓰러써요]. The ㅅ is tense after ㄱ, and ㄹ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 고기를 냉장고에 안 넣었어요. 결국 부패했어요.
common.note: The meat is the understood subject of the second sentence.

language_specific.morphology: 부패했어요 = 부패하- + -였어요, contracted from 부패하였어요.

common.sentence: 반죽을 따뜻한 곳에 뒀어요. 두 배로 부풀었어요.
common.note: The dough is the understood subject of the second sentence.

language_specific.morphology: 부풀었어요 = 부풀- + -었어요, the past polite form of 부풀다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 반죽이 부풀다: dough rises or expands.

common.sentence: 풍선을 며칠 뒀어요. 바람이 빠져 쪼그라들었어요.
common.note: The balloon is the understood subject of the final clause.

language_specific.morphology: 쪼그라들었어요 = 쪼그라들- + -었어요, the past polite form of 쪼그라들다.

common.sentence: 이 모직 치마를 보세요. 뜨거운 물에서 오그라들었어요.
common.note: The wool skirt is the understood subject of the second sentence.

language_specific.morphology: 오그라들었어요 = 오그라들- + -었어요, the past polite form of 오그라들다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 모직 치마가 오그라들다: a wool skirt shrinks and becomes wrinkled.

common.sentence: 연필에 힘을 너무 줬어요. 가운데에서 부러졌어요.
common.note: The pencil is the omitted subject of the second sentence.

language_specific.morphology: 부러졌어요 = 부러지- + -었어요, contracted from 부러지었어요.

common.sentence: 컵이 바닥에 떨어졌어요. 산산이 깨졌어요.
common.note: The cup is the understood subject of the second sentence.

language_specific.morphology: 깨졌어요 = 깨지- + -었어요, contracted from 깨지었어요.

common.sentence: 공장에 가스통이 있었어요. 곧 폭발했어요.
common.note: The gas cylinder is the understood subject of the second sentence.

language_specific.morphology: 폭발했어요 = 폭발하- + -였어요, contracted from 폭발하였어요.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 폭발했어요 [폭빨해써요]. The ㅂ is pronounced tense after ㄱ.

common.sentence: 아이가 우유를 마시다가 바닥에 흘렸어요.
common.note: The child remains the actor and the milk is the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 흘렸어요 = 흘리- + -었어요, contracted from 흘리었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 우유를 바닥에 흘리다: spill milk on the floor.

common.sentence: 제가 종을 샀어요. 문 앞에 매달았어요.
common.note: The speaker and the bell are the understood subject and object.

language_specific.morphology: 매달았어요 = 매달- + -았어요, the past polite form of 매달다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 종을 문 앞에 매달다: hang a bell in front of a door.

common.sentence: 고양이가 새를 봤어요. 한참 쳐다봤어요.
common.note: The cat and bird are the omitted subject and object of the second sentence.

language_specific.morphology: 쳐다봤어요 = 쳐다보- + -았어요, contracted from 쳐다보았어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 새를 쳐다보다: look at a bird.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 쳐다봤어요 [처다봐써요]. The glide in 쳐 is simplified in standard pronunciation.

common.sentence: 동생이 장난감을 가져와 바닥에 늘어놓았어요.
common.note: 동생 remains the actor and the toys are the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 늘어놓았어요 = 늘어놓- + -았어요, the past polite form of the lexical compound 늘어놓다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 장난감을 바닥에 늘어놓다: lay toys out on the floor.

common.sentence: 아기가 제 손가락을 잡고 꼭 쥐었어요.
common.note: The baby remains the actor and the finger is the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 쥐었어요 = 쥐- + -었어요, the past polite form of 쥐다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 손가락을 쥐다: grip a finger.

common.sentence: 제가 젖은 수건을 잡고 물을 쥐어짰어요.
common.note: The speaker remains the actor; the water is squeezed out of the towel.

language_specific.morphology: 쥐어짰어요 = 쥐어짜- + -았어요, contracted from 쥐어짜았어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 수건에서 물을 쥐어짜다: squeeze water out of a towel.

common.sentence: 민수가 철사를 잡고 양손으로 비틀었어요.
common.note: 민수 remains the actor and the wire is the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 비틀었어요 = 비틀- + -었어요, the past polite form of 비틀다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 철사를 비틀다: twist wire.

common.sentence: 지수가 주머니를 찢었어요. 바늘과 실로 꿰맸어요.
common.note: 지수 and 주머니 are the omitted subject and object of the second sentence.

language_specific.morphology: 꿰맸어요 = 꿰매- + -었어요, contracted from 꿰매었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 찢어진 주머니를 꿰매다: sew up a torn pocket.

common.sentence: 제가 구슬을 골랐어요. 실에 하나씩 꿰었어요.
common.note: The speaker and the beads are the understood subject and object.

language_specific.morphology: 꿰었어요 = 꿰- + -었어요, the past polite form of 꿰다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 구슬을 실에 꿰다: thread beads onto a string.

common.sentence: 민수가 설거지를 시작했어요. 소매를 걷어붙였어요.
common.note: 민수 is the omitted subject of the second sentence.

language_specific.morphology: 걷어붙였어요 = 걷어붙이- + -었어요, contracted from 걷어붙이었어요.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 걷어붙였어요 [거더부처써요]. Consonants link to following vowels, and the glide in 쳐 is simplified.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 소매를 걷어붙이다: roll up sleeves.

common.sentence: 배에 물이 찼어요. 선원이 양동이로 퍼냈어요.
common.note: The water in the boat is the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 퍼냈어요 = 퍼내- + -었어요, contracted from 퍼내었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 배에서 물을 퍼내다: bail water out of a boat.

common.sentence: 지수가 국을 끓였어요. 한 그릇 떠냈어요.
common.note: 지수 remains the actor and the soup is the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 떠냈어요 = 떠내- + -었어요, contracted from 떠내었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 국을 한 그릇 떠내다: ladle out a bowl of soup.

common.sentence: 국 위에 기름이 떠 있었어요. 제가 걷어냈어요.
common.note: The oil on the soup is the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 걷어냈어요 = 걷어내- + -었어요, contracted from 걷어내었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 국 위의 기름을 걷어내다: skim oil off soup.

common.sentence: 아버지가 강에서 낚시했어요. 큰 물고기를 낚았어요.
common.meaning: caught it with a fishing line
common.note: 아버지 remains the understood subject of the second sentence.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 물고기를 낚다: catch a fish with a line.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 낚았어요 [나까써요]. The ㄲ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 아이가 공을 들고 친구에게 던졌어요.
common.note: The child remains the actor and the ball is the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 던졌어요 = 던지- + -었어요, contracted from 던지었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 공을 친구에게 던지다: throw a ball to a friend.

common.sentence: 제가 열쇠를 잃어버려서 가방을 뒤졌어요.
common.note: The speaker remains the subject of the search.

language_specific.morphology: 뒤졌어요 = 뒤지- + -었어요, contracted from 뒤지었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 가방을 뒤지다: search through a bag.

common.sentence: 지수가 길을 잃었어요. 온 길을 되짚었어요.
common.note: 지수 remains the understood subject of the second sentence.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 온 길을 되짚다: retrace the route one came by.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 되짚었어요 [되지퍼써요]. The final ㅍ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 제가 추워서 외투를 어깨에 걸쳤어요.
common.note: The speaker remains the subject of the action.

language_specific.morphology: 걸쳤어요 = 걸치- + -었어요, contracted from 걸치었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 외투를 어깨에 걸치다: drape a coat over one's shoulders.

common.sentence: 지수가 목도리를 골라 목에 둘렀어요.
common.note: 지수 remains the actor and the scarf is the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 둘렀어요 = 두르- + -었어요; the 르 irregular form has ㄹㄹ and 러.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 목도리를 목에 두르다: wrap a scarf around one's neck.

common.sentence: 아이가 신발을 신었어요. 끈도 혼자 맸어요.
common.note: The child remains the understood subject; 끈 refers to the shoelaces.

language_specific.morphology: 맸어요 = 매- + -었어요, contracted from 매었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 신발 끈을 매다: tie shoelaces.

common.sentence: 제가 병을 씻었어요. 먼저 라벨을 뗐어요.
common.note: The speaker remains the subject; 라벨 belongs to the bottle.

language_specific.morphology: 뗐어요 = 떼- + -었어요, contracted from 떼었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 병에서 라벨을 떼다: peel a label off a bottle.

common.sentence: 직원이 플라스틱 조각을 맞추고 접착했어요.
common.note: The worker remains the actor and the plastic pieces are the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 접착했어요 = 접착하- + -였어요, contracted from 접착하였어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 조각을 접착하다: bond pieces together with adhesive.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 접착했어요 [접차캐써요]. The final ㄱ combines with following ㅎ to produce ㅋ.

common.sentence: 직원이 안내문을 인쇄해 문에 부착했어요.
common.note: The worker remains the actor and the notice is the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 부착했어요 = 부착하- + -였어요, contracted from 부착하였어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 안내문을 문에 부착하다: attach a notice to a door.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 부착했어요 [부차캐써요]. The final ㄱ combines with following ㅎ to produce ㅋ.

common.sentence: 지수가 케이크를 만들고 딸기로 장식했어요.
common.note: 지수 remains the actor and the cake is the understood object.

language_specific.morphology: 장식했어요 = 장식하- + -였어요, contracted from 장식하였어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 케이크를 딸기로 장식하다: decorate a cake with strawberries.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 장식했어요 [장시캐써요]. The final ㄱ combines with following ㅎ to produce ㅋ.

common.sentence: 아이가 리본을 묶고 양 끝을 길게 늘어뜨렸어요.
common.note: The child remains the actor; 양 끝 refers to the ends of the ribbon.

language_specific.morphology: 늘어뜨렸어요 = 늘어뜨리- + -었어요, contracted from 늘어뜨리었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 리본의 끝을 늘어뜨리다: let the ends of a ribbon hang down.

common.sentence: 짐이 무거운데 저를 도와주실 수 있을까요?
common.part_of_speech: verb phrase with a tentative ability-question ending

language_specific.morphology: 도와주+시+ㄹ 수 있+을까요: honorific -(으)시- and tentative ability question -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요 attach to 도와주다.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely asks another person for help with heavy luggage.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 도와주실 수 있을까요 [도와주실 쑤 이쓸까요]. 수 is pronounced with tense ㅆ after the modifier ending ㄹ, and the final ㅆ of 있 links to 을.

common.sentence: 회의 준비가 필요해서 자료를 미리 보내 주시면 좋겠어요.
common.meaning: I would appreciate it if you sent it
common.part_of_speech: verb phrase with a conditional wish construction

language_specific.morphology: 보내 주+시+면 좋+겠+어요: the honorific conditional -(으)시면 and 좋겠다 express a wish used here as a request.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 좋겠어요 [조케써요]. The final ㅎ aspirates the following ㄱ, and the final ㅆ links to the following vowel.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks the listener to send materials early so they can prepare.

common.sentence: 혼자 옮기기 힘든데 도와주시면 안 될까요?
common.part_of_speech: verb phrase with a negative permission-question appeal

language_specific.morphology: 도와주+시+면 안 되+ㄹ까요: honorific -(으)시면 combines with 안 될까요 to make a gentle appeal.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker appeals for help with moving something that is hard to move alone.

common.sentence: 창문 좀 닫아 주세요. 네, 제가 닫을게요.
common.part_of_speech: verb with a responsive commitment ending

language_specific.morphology: 닫+을게요: -(으)ㄹ게요 attaches to the consonant-final stem to express the speaker's responsive commitment.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 닫을게요 [다들께요]. The ㄱ in 게요 is pronounced tense.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker agrees to the other person's request to close the window.

common.sentence: 저녁 같이 먹어요. 약속이 있어서 가기는 좀 어렵겠어요.
common.meaning: I don't think I can go
common.part_of_speech: verb phrase with an indirect refusal construction

language_specific.morphology: 가+기+는 좀 어렵+겠+어요: nominalizer -기 and topic particle 는 mark the action being declined; 어렵겠어요 softens the refusal.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 어렵겠어요 [어렵께써요]. The ㄱ after the final consonant is pronounced tense.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker declines a dinner invitation because they already have an appointment.

common.sentence: 왜 먼저 가세요? 아이를 데리러 가야 해서요.
common.part_of_speech: verb phrase with a polite causal reply ending

language_specific.morphology: 가+아야 하+여서+요 contracts to 가야 해서요: -아서/어서요 gives a polite causal reply to the question.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker explains why they must leave first.

common.sentence: 이 버스가 시청 앞에 서나요?
common.part_of_speech: verb with a polite present inquiry ending

language_specific.morphology: 서+나요: present-tense verb ending -나요 makes a polite information inquiry.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely asks about the bus route.

common.sentence: 지금 통화하기에 괜찮은가요?
common.part_of_speech: adjective with a polite inquiry ending

language_specific.morphology: 괜찮+은가요: -(으)ㄴ가요 attaches to the consonant-final adjective stem for a polite inquiry.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker checks considerately whether the listener can talk now.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 괜찮은가요 [괜차는가요]. The ㅎ is not pronounced before the vowel, and ㄴ links to 은.

common.sentence: 실례지만 이 행사 담당자이신가요?
common.meaning: are you the person in charge?

language_specific.morphology: 담당자+이+시+ㄴ가요: the copula 이다 takes honorific -시- and interrogative -ㄴ가요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely asks the listener about their role at the event.

common.sentence: 오늘 야근이 있어서 모임에 못 갈 것 같아요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker explains why they cannot attend a gathering.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 야근이 있다: have overtime work at night.

common.sentence: 제가 내일 당직이라서 내일 약속을 미루면 좋겠어요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks to postpone tomorrow's plan because they are on duty then.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 당직이다: be assigned to duty.

common.sentence: 내일 면접이 있어서 일찍 퇴근해도 될까요?

language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks to leave work early because of an interview.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 면접이 있다: have an interview.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 면접이 [면저비]. The final ㅂ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 오후에 진료를 받아야 해서 먼저 가겠습니다.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely explains an early departure.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 진료를 받다: receive medical care.

common.sentence: 건강 검진 예약이 있어서 오전 회의는 어렵겠어요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker declines a morning meeting because of a screening appointment.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 건강 검진: a health screening.

common.sentence: 의사 선생님, 진찰을 먼저 받아도 될까요?

language_specific.social_context: A patient politely asks the doctor about being examined first.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 진찰을 받다: be examined by a medical professional.

common.sentence: 다음 주에 연수에 가서 만나기 어렵겠어요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker declines a meeting because they will attend training.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 연수에 가다: go to a training program.

common.sentence: 출장 중이라서 서류 확인은 내일 해도 될까요?

language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks to check a document later because they are away on business.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 출장 중이다: be on a business trip.

common.sentence: 출산 휴가를 앞두고 업무를 나눠 주시겠어요?

language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks for work to be distributed before their leave.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 출산 휴가를 앞두다: be approaching maternity leave.

common.sentence: 몸이 좋지 않아 오늘 병가를 내겠습니다.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker tells someone at work that they will take sick leave.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 병가를 내다: take sick leave.

common.sentence: 은행에 가야 해서 오후에 반차를 써도 될까요?

language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks to take the afternoon off to visit a bank.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 반차를 쓰다: take half a day of leave.

common.sentence: 가족 경조사가 있어서 이번 모임은 빠지겠습니다.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely excuses themselves from a gathering for a family occasion.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 경조사가 있다: have a celebration or bereavement to attend to.

common.sentence: 제게는 삭제 권한이 없어서 담당자에게 부탁해 주세요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker redirects a deletion request to the person responsible.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 삭제 권한이 없다: lack permission to delete.

common.sentence: 일정은 제 재량으로 바꾸기 어려워서 팀장님께 여쭤볼게요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker offers to ask the team leader about a schedule change.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 제 재량으로 바꾸다: change something at one's own discretion.

common.sentence: 지금은 여유가 없어서 내일 도와드려도 될까요?

language_specific.social_context: The speaker offers to help later because they have no capacity now.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 여유가 없다: have no spare time or capacity.

common.sentence: 자꾸 선물을 받아서 민망해서 이번에는 사양할게요.

language_specific.morphology: 민망하+여서 contracts to 민망해서; -아서/어서 gives the reason for declining.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely declines another gift because repeated gifts feel embarrassing.

common.sentence: 사적인 질문은 좀 거북해서 답하지 않겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 거북하+여서 contracts to 거북해서; -아서/어서 gives the reason for declining.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker declines to answer a personal question that makes them uncomfortable.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 질문이 거북하다: a question feels uncomfortable.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 거북해서 [거부캐서]. The final ㄱ combines with ㅎ to produce ㅋ.

common.sentence: 알림이 계속 울려서 성가신데 잠시 꺼 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 성가시+ㄴ데: -(으)ㄴ데 attaches to the vowel-final adjective stem and introduces the request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks someone to turn off repeatedly sounding notifications.

common.sentence: 짐을 맡겨서 몸이 가뿐해서 제가 앞장설게요.

language_specific.morphology: 가뿐하+여서 contracts to 가뿐해서; -아서/어서 gives the reason for the offer.
language_specific.social_context: After leaving their luggage, the speaker offers to lead the way.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 몸이 가뿐하다: one's body feels light and unburdened.

common.sentence: 시험이 끝나 마음이 홀가분해서 제가 정리할게요.

language_specific.morphology: 홀가분하+여서 contracts to 홀가분해서; -아서/어서 gives the reason for the offer.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker offers to tidy up after the exam has ended.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 마음이 홀가분하다: feel mentally relieved of a burden.

common.sentence: 이 일을 혼자 맡기에는 벅차서 도움을 부탁드려요.

language_specific.morphology: 벅차+아서 contracts to 벅차서; -아서/어서 gives the reason for requesting help.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks for help because taking on the work alone is overwhelming.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 일을 혼자 맡기에는 벅차다: be overwhelmed at the prospect of handling work alone.

common.sentence: 같은 음식이 좀 지겨워서 오늘은 다른 걸 먹으면 좋겠어요.
common.meaning: because I am tired of it

language_specific.morphology: 지겹+어서 becomes 지겨워서: the ㅂ-irregular stem changes ㅂ to 우 before -어서, producing 워.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely suggests different food after repeatedly eating the same thing.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 같은 음식이 지겹다: be tired of the same food.

common.sentence: 계속 앉아 있어서 따분해서 잠깐 걸으면 좋겠어요.

language_specific.morphology: 따분하+여서 contracts to 따분해서; -아서/어서 gives the reason for the suggestion.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker suggests a short walk after sitting for a long time.

common.sentence: 제 발표에 대해 솔직한 의견을 주시면 좋겠어요.

language_specific.morphology: 솔직하+ㄴ gives 솔직한: the adjective modifier ending -ㄴ attaches to the vowel-final stem.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks for frank feedback on their presentation.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 솔직한 의견: a frank opinion.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 솔직한 [솔찌칸]. ㅈ is tense after ㄹ in this Sino-Korean base, and ㄱ combines with ㅎ to produce ㅋ.

common.sentence: 무례한 질문일 수 있지만 성함을 여쭤봐도 될까요?

language_specific.morphology: 무례하+ㄴ gives 무례한: the adjective modifier ending -ㄴ attaches to the vowel-final stem.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker cautiously asks the listener's name.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 무례한 질문: an impolite question.

common.sentence: 손님께 예의 바른 말로 다시 안내해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 예의 is a noun; 바르- + ㄴ forms 바른, retaining ㅡ. The noun and adjective are spaced in 예의 바른.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks someone to address a guest courteously.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 예의 바른 말: courteous language.

common.sentence: 수고스러우시겠지만 서류를 다시 확인해 주시겠어요?
common.meaning: although it may be a bother

language_specific.morphology: 수고스럽- + 으시 + 겠 + 지만 becomes 수고스러우시겠지만: before vowel-initial honorific -(으)시-, irregular ㅂ changes to 우; 겠지만 introduces the acknowledged inconvenience.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker acknowledges the effort involved in asking the listener to check a document again.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 수고스러우시겠지만 [수고스러우시겓찌만]. Final ㅆ is realized as ㄷ before the tense ㅈ in 지만.

common.sentence: 기다리시게 해서 송구스럽지만 조금만 더 기다려 주십시오.

language_specific.morphology: 송구스럽+지만: -지만 attaches directly to the stem and introduces the apologetic request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker apologetically asks someone who has already waited to wait longer.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 송구스럽지만 [송구스럽찌만]. The ㅈ in 지만 is pronounced tense after ㅂ.

common.sentence: 교수님, 다음 주 수업을 청강해도 될까요?
common.meaning: audit a class, in a permission question

language_specific.morphology: 청강하+여도 contracts to 청강해도; -아/어도 되다 asks permission.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks a professor for permission to attend a class as an auditor.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 수업을 청강하다: audit a class.

common.sentence: 이 번역은 전문가에게 의뢰하면 좋겠어요.
common.meaning: if someone commissions or requests a service

language_specific.morphology: 의뢰하+면: conditional -(으)면 introduces a suggestion with 좋겠어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker tactfully suggests commissioning a specialist to translate.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 전문가에게 번역을 의뢰하다: commission a specialist to translate.

common.sentence: 일정이 겹쳐서 회의 시간을 조정해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 조정하+여 contracts to 조정해; the form connects to 주시겠어요 in a polite request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks for a meeting time to be adjusted because of a scheduling conflict.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 회의 시간을 조정하다: adjust a meeting time.

common.sentence: 버스를 놓쳐도 걸어갈 수 있어요.

language_specific.morphology: 놓치- + -어도 contracts to 놓쳐도. Verb stem + -아/어도 introduces a concessive condition.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 놓쳐도 [노처도]. ㅎ is omitted before ㅊ, and written 쳐 is pronounced 처 here.

common.sentence: 방이 좁아도 책상은 들어가요.

language_specific.morphology: 좁- + -아도 gives 좁아도. Adjective stem + -아/어도 introduces a concessive state.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 좁아도 [조바도]. The final ㅂ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 학생이어도 이 박물관에서는 돈을 내요.
common.meaning: even though one is a student

language_specific.morphology: 학생 + 이- + -어도 gives 학생이어도. The copula 이다 attaches to the noun; -어도 marks concession.

common.sentence: 알람을 맞췄는데도 오늘 늦게 일어났어요.

language_specific.morphology: 맞추- + -었- + -는데도 contracts to 맞췄는데도. The past marker precedes -는데도, which adds 도 to the background ending -는데 and marks concession.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 알람을 맞추다: set an alarm.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 맞췄는데도 [맏춴는데도]. Final ㅈ is realized as ㄷ before ㅊ, and the past ㅆ is pronounced ㄴ before ㄴ; the contracted vowel remains ㅝ.

common.sentence: 학교가 가까운데도 지수는 택시를 탔어요.

language_specific.morphology: 가깝- + -은데도 gives 가까운데도: irregular ㅂ changes to 우 before the vowel. Adjective stem + -(으)ㄴ데도 marks an actual concessive state.

common.sentence: 오래 쓴 가방인데도 아주 깔끔해요.

language_specific.morphology: 깔끔하- + -여요 contracts to 깔끔해요.

common.sentence: 민수는 몸이 허약해도 매일 산책해요.

language_specific.morphology: 허약하- + -여도 contracts to 허약해도.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 허약해도 [허야캐도]. The final ㄱ and following ㅎ combine as ㅋ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 몸이 허약하다: be physically weak.

common.sentence: 계획이 빈틈없는데도 지수는 다시 확인했어요.
common.meaning: despite being thorough and leaving no gaps

language_specific.morphology: 빈틈없- + -는데도 gives 빈틈없는데도. An adjective ending in 없다 takes -는데도.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 빈틈없는데도 [빈트멈는데도]. The ㅂ in 없 is pronounced ㅁ before ㄴ.

common.sentence: 분위기가 엄숙한데도 아이는 웃었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 엄숙하- + -ㄴ데도 gives 엄숙한데도.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 엄숙한데도 [엄수칸데도]. The final ㄱ and following ㅎ combine as ㅋ.

common.sentence: 계속 부탁했는데도 지수는 단호하게 거절했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 단호하- + -게 gives 단호하게, modifying the following verb.

common.sentence: 시험에 떨어졌는데도 민수는 담담하게 이야기했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 담담하- + -게 gives 담담하게, modifying the following verb.

common.sentence: 친구의 작품인데도 지수는 냉정하게 평가했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 냉정하- + -게 gives 냉정하게, modifying the following verb.

common.sentence: 제가 늦었는데도 선생님은 너그럽게 웃으셨어요.

language_specific.morphology: 너그럽- + -게 gives 너그럽게. The ㅂ remains before consonant-initial -게.
language_specific.social_context: A speaker describes a teacher's response using honorific speech.

common.sentence: 감독님은 작은 실수에는 관대해도 지각은 싫어하세요.

language_specific.morphology: 관대하- + -여도 contracts to 관대해도.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker refers respectfully to a director.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 실수에 관대하다: be lenient about mistakes.

common.sentence: 친구들이 말려도 민수는 완고하게 계획을 고집했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 완고하- + -게 gives 완고하게, modifying the following verb.

common.sentence: 지수는 고집스러운데도 이번에는 제 의견을 들었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 고집스럽- + -은데도 gives 고집스러운데도: irregular ㅂ changes to 우 before the vowel.

common.sentence: 상을 받았는데도 지수는 겸손하게 말했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 겸손하- + -게 gives 겸손하게, modifying the following verb.

common.sentence: 민수는 경험이 적은데도 교만하게 남의 조언을 무시했어요.
common.meaning: arrogantly, with an inflated view of oneself

language_specific.morphology: 교만하- + -게 gives 교만하게, modifying the following verb.

common.sentence: 처음 만났는데도 민수는 거만한 태도로 말했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 거만하- + -ㄴ gives 거만한, which modifies 태도.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 거만한 태도: a haughty manner.

common.sentence: 민수는 잘못했는데도 건방지게 선생님께 대답했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 건방지- + -게 gives 건방지게, modifying the following verb.
language_specific.social_context: Minsu answers a teacher impudently.

common.sentence: 아버지는 무뚝뚝해도 제 생일은 꼭 챙겨요.

language_specific.morphology: 무뚝뚝하- + -여도 contracts to 무뚝뚝해도.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 무뚝뚝해도 [무뚝뚜캐도]. The final ㄱ and following ㅎ combine as ㅋ.

common.sentence: 바쁜데도 언니는 아이에게 다정하게 말했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 다정하- + -게 gives 다정하게, modifying the following verb.

common.sentence: 처음 만났는데도 옆집 분은 친근하게 말을 걸었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 친근하- + -게 gives 친근하게, modifying the following verb.

common.sentence: 이 단어는 생소해도 뜻을 짐작할 수 있어요.

language_specific.morphology: 생소하- + -여도 contracts to 생소해도.

common.sentence: 이 영화는 결말이 진부한데도 재미있어요.

language_specific.morphology: 진부하- + -ㄴ데도 gives 진부한데도.

common.sentence: 냉장고에 사흘 있었는데도 채소가 신선해요.

language_specific.morphology: 신선하- + -여요 contracts to 신선해요.

common.sentence: 다들 평범한 생각이라고 했는데도 그 생각은 참신했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 참신하- + -였어요 contracts to 참신했어요.

common.sentence: 모양은 특이해도 이 컵은 쓰기 편해요.

language_specific.morphology: 특이하- + -여도 contracts to 특이해도.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 특이해도 [트기해도]. The final ㄱ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 겉모습은 평범해도 이 식당의 음식은 맛있어요.

language_specific.morphology: 평범하- + -여도 contracts to 평범해도.

common.sentence: 지수는 어린데도 그림에 비범한 재능이 보여요.

language_specific.morphology: 비범하- + -ㄴ gives 비범한, which modifies 재능.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 비범한 재능: extraordinary talent.

common.sentence: 일이 어려웠는데도 유능한 직원이 금방 해결했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 유능하- + -ㄴ gives 유능한, which modifies 직원.

common.sentence: 경력이 긴데도 그 관리자는 무능했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 무능하- + -였어요 contracts to 무능했어요.

common.sentence: 민수는 운전이 미숙한데도 혼자 먼 길을 갔어요.

language_specific.morphology: 미숙하- + -ㄴ데도 gives 미숙한데도.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 미숙한데도 [미수칸데도]. The final ㄱ and following ㅎ combine as ㅋ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 운전이 미숙하다: be inexperienced at driving.

common.sentence: 이 천은 뻣뻣해도 빨면 부드러워져요.

language_specific.morphology: 뻣뻣하- + -여도 contracts to 뻣뻣해도.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 뻣뻣해도 [뻗뻐태도]. The final ㅅ and following ㅎ combine as ㅌ.

common.sentence: 처음 만든 의자라서 어설퍼도 앉을 수 있어요.

language_specific.morphology: 어설프- + -어도 gives 어설퍼도; stem-final ㅡ drops before -어도.

common.sentence: 민수는 어수룩해 보여도 돈 계산은 정확해요.

language_specific.morphology: 어수룩하- + -여 contracts to 어수룩해 before 보이다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 어수룩해 [어수루캐]. The final ㄱ and following ㅎ combine as ㅋ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 어수룩하다: be naive or somewhat gullible; 어수룩해 보이다: appear that way.

common.sentence: 길이 막혔는데도 노련한 기사는 제시간에 도착했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 노련하- + -ㄴ gives 노련한, which modifies 기사.

common.sentence: 작업이 어려워도 숙련된 기술자는 잘해요.

language_specific.morphology: 숙련되- + -ㄴ gives 숙련된, which modifies 기술자 and describes an acquired skill.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 숙련된 [숭년된]. The ㄱ becomes ㅇ before ㄹ, and ㄹ becomes ㄴ.

common.sentence: 시간이 빠듯한데도 지수는 아침을 먹었어요.
common.meaning: despite being tight or barely sufficient

language_specific.morphology: 빠듯하- + -ㄴ데도 gives 빠듯한데도.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 빠듯한데도 [빠드탄데도]. The final ㅅ and following ㅎ combine as ㅌ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시간이 빠듯하다: have very little time to spare.

common.sentence: 가격이 터무니없는데도 민수는 그 차를 샀어요.

language_specific.morphology: 터무니없- + -는데도 gives 터무니없는데도. An adjective ending in 없다 takes -는데도.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 터무니없는데도 [터무니엄는데도]. The ㅂ in 없 is pronounced ㅁ before ㄴ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 가격이 터무니없다: the price is absurdly unreasonable.

common.sentence: 민수 씨! 네, 여기 있어요.
지영 씨! 예, 듣고 있어요.
문을 닫아 주세요. 네, 닫을게요.
common.note: The separate 닫을게요 expresses the undertaking.

common.sentence: 내일 아홉 시에 만나요. 네?

language_specific.prosody: Target: Use questioning intonation to request a repeat.

common.sentence: 오늘 커피 안 마셔요? 네, 안 마셔요.
오늘 커피 안 마셔요? 아니요, 마셔요.
회의는 세 시에 시작해요. 맞아요.

language_specific.morphology: 맞- + -아요 gives 맞아요, the polite agreement response from 맞다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 맞아요 [마자요]. The final consonant moves to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 이 의자가 정말 편해요. 맞아요.

language_specific.morphology: 맞- + -아요 gives 맞아요, the polite agreement response from 맞다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 맞아요 [마자요]. The final consonant moves to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 고객의 질문에 응답했어요? 네, 이메일을 보냈어요.

language_specific.morphology: 응답하- + -였어요 contracts to 응답했어요, the past polite form of 응답하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 질문에 응답하다: respond to a question.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 응답했어요 [응다패써요]. The final ㅂ combines with ㅎ, and the past ending is pronounced with a tense consonant.

common.sentence: 면접 질문에 대답했어요? 네, 모두 답했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 대답하- + -였어요 contracts to 대답했어요, the past polite form of 대답하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 질문에 대답하다: answer a question.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 대답했어요 [대다패써요]. The final ㅂ combines with ㅎ, and the past ending is pronounced with a tense consonant.

common.sentence: 아기가 음악에 반응해요? 네, 웃어요.

language_specific.morphology: 반응하- + -여요 contracts to 반응해요, the polite form of 반응하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 음악에 반응하다: react to music.

common.sentence: 그 이유를 듣고 수긍했어요? 네, 이해했어요.
common.meaning: Did someone accept it as reasonable?

language_specific.morphology: 수긍하- + -였어요 contracts to 수긍했어요, the past polite form of 수긍하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이유를 듣고 수긍하다: accept something as reasonable after hearing the reason.

common.sentence: 변화의 가능성을 긍정해요? 네, 가능하다고 생각해요.

language_specific.morphology: 긍정하- + -여요 contracts to 긍정해요, the polite form of 긍정하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 가능성을 긍정하다: affirm a possibility.

common.sentence: 그 소문을 부정했어요? 네, 사실이 아니래요.

language_specific.morphology: 부정하- + -였어요 contracts to 부정했어요, the past polite form of 부정하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 소문을 부정하다: deny a rumor.

common.sentence: 계획에 반대해요? 네, 비용이 너무 커요.

language_specific.morphology: 반대하- + -여요 contracts to 반대해요, the polite form of 반대하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 계획에 반대하다: oppose a plan.

common.sentence: 제안을 거부했어요? 네, 조건이 맞지 않았어요.

language_specific.morphology: 거부하- + -였어요 contracts to 거부했어요, the past polite form of 거부하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 제안을 거부하다: reject an offer.

common.sentence: 부탁을 승낙했어요? 네, 도와주기로 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 승낙하- + -였어요 contracts to 승낙했어요, the past polite form of 승낙하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 부탁을 승낙하다: consent to a request.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 승낙했어요 [승나캐써요]. The final ㄱ combines with ㅎ, and the past ending is pronounced with a tense consonant.

common.sentence: 이사하고 외로웠어요. 네, 그 마음에 공감해요.

language_specific.morphology: 공감하- + -여요 contracts to 공감해요, the polite form of 공감하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 마음에 공감하다: empathize with someone's feelings.

common.sentence: 수정안을 수용했어요? 네, 그 안으로 진행해요.

language_specific.morphology: 수용하- + -였어요 contracts to 수용했어요, the past polite form of 수용하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 수정안을 수용하다: accept a revised proposal.

common.sentence: 관객이 노래에 호응했어요? 네, 함께 박수를 쳤어요.

language_specific.morphology: 호응하- + -였어요 contracts to 호응했어요, the past polite form of 호응하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 노래에 호응하다: respond enthusiastically to a song.

common.sentence: 매일 운동하기로 다짐했어요? 네, 오늘부터 시작해요.
common.meaning: Did someone resolve to do it?

language_specific.morphology: 다짐하- + -였어요 contracts to 다짐했어요, the past polite form of 다짐하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 운동하기로 다짐하다: resolve to exercise.

common.sentence: 민수 씨 의견에 동조해요? 네, 저도 그렇게 생각해요.
common.meaning: Does someone agree and align themselves with it?

language_specific.morphology: 동조하- + -여요 contracts to 동조해요, the polite form of 동조하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 의견에 동조하다: align oneself with an opinion.

common.sentence: 새 대표를 지지해요? 네, 일하는 방식을 믿어요.

language_specific.morphology: 지지하- + -여요 contracts to 지지해요, the polite form of 지지하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 대표를 지지하다: support a representative.

common.sentence: 친구를 옹호했어요? 네, 친구의 행동을 변호했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 옹호하- + -였어요 contracts to 옹호했어요, the past polite form of 옹호하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 친구를 옹호하다: defend a friend.

common.sentence: 제가 약속을 어겨서 저를 책망했어요? 네, 화가 났어요.

language_specific.morphology: 책망하- + -였어요 contracts to 책망했어요, the past polite form of 책망하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 약속을 어겨서 사람을 책망하다: reproach someone for breaking a promise.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 책망했어요 [챙망해써요]. ㄱ assimilates to the following nasal, and the past ending is pronounced with a tense consonant.

common.sentence: 팀장이 실수를 질책했어요? 네, 회의에서 크게 혼났어요.

language_specific.morphology: 질책하- + -였어요 contracts to 질책했어요, the past polite form of 질책하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 실수를 질책하다: rebuke someone for a mistake.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 질책했어요 [질채캐써요]. The final ㄱ combines with ㅎ, and the past ending is pronounced with a tense consonant.

common.sentence: 아이가 벽에 낙서해서 꾸짖었어요? 네, 아이가 다시는 안 하기로 했어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 낙서해서 꾸짖다: scold someone for drawing on a surface.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 꾸짖었어요 [꾸지저써요]. The stem-final ㅈ moves to the following vowel, and the past ending is pronounced with a tense consonant.

common.sentence: 늦은 배송에 항의했어요? 네, 판매자에게 연락했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 항의하- + -였어요 contracts to 항의했어요, the past polite form of 항의하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 배송에 항의하다: complain about a delivery.

common.sentence: 왜 잘못이 없다고 항변했어요? 제가 한 일이 아니었어요.
common.meaning: Did someone protest in their defense?

language_specific.morphology: 항변하- + -였어요 contracts to 항변했어요, the past polite form of 항변하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 잘못이 없다고 항변하다: protest that one is not at fault.

common.sentence: 늦은 이유를 변명했어요? 네, 차가 막혔다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 변명하- + -였어요 contracts to 변명했어요, the past polite form of 변명하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 늦은 이유를 변명하다: make an excuse for being late.

common.sentence: 사진이 잘린 이유를 해명했어요? 네, 실수였다고 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 해명하- + -였어요 contracts to 해명했어요, the past polite form of 해명하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 잘린 이유를 해명하다: explain the reason something was cut.

common.sentence: 숫자를 잘못 썼다고 시인했어요? 네, 제 실수였어요.

language_specific.morphology: 시인하- + -였어요 contracts to 시인했어요, the past polite form of 시인하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 잘못 썼다고 시인하다: admit having written something incorrectly.

common.sentence: 그 사람이 왜 거짓말을 하겠냐고 반문했어요? 네, 그렇게 물었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 반문하- + -였어요 contracts to 반문했어요, the past polite form of 반문하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 왜 하겠냐고 반문하다: ask back why one would do something.

common.sentence: 주소를 다시 재확인했어요? 네, 지도에서도 찾아봤어요.

language_specific.morphology: 재확인하- + -였어요 contracts to 재확인했어요, the past polite form of 재확인하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 주소를 재확인하다: check an address again.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 재확인했어요 [재화긴해써요]. The final ㄱ moves to the following vowel, and the past ending is pronounced with a tense consonant.

common.sentence: 제가 화났다고 오해했어요? 아니요, 피곤하다고 생각했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 오해하- + -였어요 contracts to 오해했어요, the past polite form of 오해하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 화났다고 오해하다: mistakenly think someone is angry.

common.sentence: 사고 당시 상황을 진술했어요? 네, 경찰에게 말했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 진술하- + -였어요 contracts to 진술했어요, the past polite form of 진술하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 상황을 진술하다: give an account of a situation.

common.sentence: 목격한 일을 법정에서 증언했어요? 네, 본 것을 말했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 증언하- + -였어요 contracts to 증언했어요, the past polite form of 증언하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 목격한 일을 증언하다: testify about what one witnessed.

common.sentence: 친구에게 고민을 토로했어요? 네, 힘든 마음을 털어놨어요.
common.meaning: Did someone pour out their feelings?

language_specific.morphology: 토로하- + -였어요 contracts to 토로했어요, the past polite form of 토로하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 친구에게 고민을 토로하다: pour out one's worries to a friend.

common.sentence: 친구에게 좋아한다고 고백했어요? 네, 어제 말했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 고백하- + -였어요 contracts to 고백했어요, the past polite form of 고백하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 친구에게 좋아한다고 고백하다: confess one's affection to a friend.

common.sentence: 친구에게 화낸 일을 반성했어요? 네, 사과도 했어요.
common.meaning: Did someone reflect on their wrongdoing?

language_specific.morphology: 반성하- + -였어요 contracts to 반성했어요, the past polite form of 반성하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 화낸 일을 반성하다: reflect on having become angry.

common.sentence: 이 도서관은 일요일에도 열어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.morphology: 그렇군요 consists of 그렇- + -군요, a fixed polite response expressing realization of newly learned information.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '그렇군요' [그러쿠뇨]. The ㅎ and ㄱ combine as ㅋ, and ㄴ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 길이 막혀서 회의에 늦었어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.morphology: 그렇군요 consists of 그렇- + -군요, a fixed polite response expressing realization of a newly explained reason.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '그렇군요' [그러쿠뇨]. The ㅎ and ㄱ combine as ㅋ, and ㄴ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 민수가 다음 달에 이사해요. 그래요?

language_specific.morphology: 그래요 comes from 그렇- + -어요; the ㅎ-irregular stem contracts to 그래.
language_specific.prosody: Target: Use rising questioning intonation to check the surprising news.

common.sentence: 점심은 여기에서 먹어요. 그래요.

language_specific.morphology: 그래요 comes from 그렇- + -어요; the ㅎ-irregular stem contracts to 그래.
language_specific.social_context: The second speaker accepts the first speaker's proposal.

common.sentence: 창문을 열어도 돼요? 그래요.

language_specific.morphology: 그래요 comes from 그렇- + -어요; the ㅎ-irregular stem contracts to 그래.
language_specific.social_context: The second speaker grants the requested permission.

common.sentence: 비가 그쳤어요. 우리 같이 걸을까요?

language_specific.morphology: 걸을까요 consists of 걷- + -을까요. The ㄷ in 걷- changes to ㄹ before the vowel; -(으)ㄹ까요 asks for the listener's opinion about a shared action.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 우리 같이 걸을까요?: suggest walking together.

common.sentence: 차와 커피가 있어요. 저는 차를 마실래요.
common.meaning: I'll have; I choose to drink

language_specific.morphology: 마실래요 consists of 마시- + -ㄹ래요; the ending expresses the speaker's voluntary choice.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 저는 차를 마실래요: the speaker chooses tea.

common.sentence: 시간이 남아요. 우리 같이 산책할래요?
common.meaning: Would you like to take a walk?

language_specific.morphology: 산책할래요 consists of 산책하- + -ㄹ래요; as a question, the ending asks about the listener's preference.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker invites someone in an ordinary social setting.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 우리 같이 산책할래요?: invite the listener to walk together.

common.sentence: 저는 사진 속 변화를 눈치챘어요. 그래요?

language_specific.morphology: 눈치챘어요 consists of 눈치채- + -었어요, contracted to 눈치챘어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 변화를 눈치채다: notice a change.

common.sentence: 저는 졸업식에서 변화를 실감했어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.morphology: 실감했어요 consists of 실감하- + -였어요, contracted to 실감했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 변화를 실감하다: feel that a change is real.

common.sentence: 저는 그 그림을 보고 감탄했어요. 그래요?

language_specific.morphology: 감탄했어요 consists of 감탄하- + -였어요, contracted to 감탄했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 그림을 보고 감탄하다: admire a painting on seeing it.

common.sentence: 저는 친구의 선물에 감격했어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.morphology: 감격했어요 consists of 감격하- + -였어요, contracted to 감격했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 선물에 감격하다: be deeply moved by a gift.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 감격했어요 [감겨캐써요]. The final ㄱ combines with following ㅎ as ㅋ; the past ㅆ links to the following vowel as a tense consonant.

common.sentence: 저는 바닷속을 상상했어요. 그래요?

language_specific.morphology: 상상했어요 consists of 상상하- + -였어요, contracted to 상상했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 바닷속을 상상하다: imagine what is under the sea.

common.sentence: 동생이 제 긴 머리를 부러워해요. 그래요?

language_specific.morphology: 부러워해요 consists of 부러워하- + -여요, contracted to 부러워해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 긴 머리를 부러워하다: envy someone's long hair.

common.sentence: 저는 자기 전에 책을 읽는 습관이 있어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 책을 읽는 습관이 있다: have a habit of reading.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 습관이 [습꽈니]. The ㄱ is pronounced tense after ㅂ, and final ㄴ links to 이.

common.sentence: 제 취미는 주말에 빵을 굽는 거예요. 그렇군요.
아이가 그림에 소질이 있어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 그림에 소질이 있다: have an aptitude for drawing.

common.sentence: 그 배우는 노래에도 재능이 있어요. 그래요?

language_specific.lexical_frame: 노래에 재능이 있다: have a talent for singing.

common.sentence: 저는 이 일이 적성에 맞아요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 일이 적성에 맞다: work suits one's aptitude.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 적성에 [적썽에]. The ㅅ is pronounced tense after ㄱ; final ㅇ remains in its syllable before 에.

common.sentence: 제 직업은 요리사예요. 그렇군요.
제 전공은 화학이에요. 그렇군요.
졸업 후 진로를 선생님과 상담했어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 졸업 후 진로: one's path after graduation.

common.sentence: 올해 목표는 책 열 권을 읽는 거예요. 그래요?
이번 연구에서 좋은 성과를 얻었어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 성과를 얻다: achieve a result.

common.sentence: 학생들을 가르치면서 보람을 느껴요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 보람을 느끼다: feel that an activity is rewarding.

common.sentence: 다음 주에 작가를 만날 기회가 있어요. 그래요?

language_specific.lexical_frame: 작가를 만날 기회: an opportunity to meet an author.

common.sentence: 내일 눈이 올 가능성이 있어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 눈이 올 가능성: the possibility of snow.

common.sentence: 문이 잠긴 사실을 이제 알았어요. 그래요?

language_specific.lexical_frame: 문이 잠긴 사실: the fact that the door is locked.

common.sentence: 기자는 사건의 진실을 찾고 있어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 사건의 진실: the truth about an incident.

common.sentence: 그 가게가 문을 닫는다고 소문이 났어요. 그래요?

language_specific.lexical_frame: 문을 닫는다고 소문이 나다: a rumor spreads that it is closing.

common.sentence: 선물은 내일까지 비밀이에요. 그래요.
공연 표가 벌써 매진됐어요. 그래요?

language_specific.morphology: 매진됐어요 consists of 매진되- + -었어요, contracted to 매진됐어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 공연 표가 매진되다: tickets for a performance sell out.

common.sentence: 그 신발은 모든 크기가 품절됐어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.morphology: 품절됐어요 consists of 품절되- + -었어요, contracted to 품절됐어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 모든 크기가 품절되다: all sizes go out of stock.

common.sentence: 눈 때문에 비행기가 결항됐어요. 그래요?

language_specific.morphology: 결항됐어요 consists of 결항되- + -었어요, contracted to 결항됐어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 비행기가 결항되다: a flight is canceled.

common.sentence: 이 사과의 원산지는 한국이에요. 그렇군요.
이 과자에 우유 성분이 들어 있어요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 우유 성분이 들어 있다: contain a milk ingredient.

common.sentence: 이 가방의 소재는 천연 가죽이에요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 가방의 소재: the material a bag is made from.

common.sentence: 역에서 분실물을 찾았어요. 그래요?

language_specific.lexical_frame: 분실물을 찾다: find a lost item.

common.sentence: 이 쿠폰의 유효기간은 이번 달까지예요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 쿠폰의 유효기간: the period during which a coupon is valid.

common.sentence: 이 주차장은 유료예요. 그렇군요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 주차장이 유료이다: a parking lot charges a fee.

common.sentence: 오늘 안에 보고서를 보내 주세요. 알겠습니다.
common.note: Here the response acknowledges the request and undertakes the task.

language_specific.morphology: 알- + -겠- + -습니다 forms the formal polite response 알겠습니다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 알겠습니다 [알겓씀니다]. Final ㅆ is realized as ㄷ before the following tense ㅅ; the ㅂ of 습니다 becomes ㅁ before ㄴ.
language_specific.social_context: One speaker makes an informal polite request; the other responds formally.

common.sentence: 내일 휴관이에요. 알아요, 어제 확인했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 알- + -아요 gives 알아요.
language_specific.social_context: The second speaker responds to a reminder and explains their prior awareness.

common.sentence: 창밖을 보세요. 눈이 오네요.
common.note: The speaker notices the snowfall firsthand.

language_specific.morphology: The verb stem 오- takes -네요 to express a newly noticed action.

common.sentence: 이 국을 먹어 보니까 짜네요.
common.note: The speaker notices the quality by tasting the soup.

language_specific.morphology: The adjective stem 짜- takes -네요 to express a newly noticed quality.

common.sentence: 민수 씨는 매일 수영해요. 아, 수영하는군요.

language_specific.morphology: The verb stem 수영하- takes -는군요 to express a newly learned fact.

common.sentence: 이분이 우리 선생님이세요. 아, 선생님이군요.
common.meaning: Oh, this person is a teacher.

language_specific.morphology: 선생님 + 이다 takes -군요 after the copula stem 이-, giving 선생님이군요.
language_specific.social_context: A speaker identifies the person after an introduction.

common.sentence: 여기서 역까지 걸어서 두 시간이에요. 멀군요.

language_specific.morphology: The adjective stem 멀- takes -군요 to express a realization.

common.sentence: 우리 어제 시간표를 봤죠. 첫차는 여섯 시에 오죠.

language_specific.morphology: 오- + -지요 gives 오지요; 오죠 uses the shortened ending -죠.
language_specific.prosody: Target: Use statement intonation to present the arrival time as shared knowledge.

common.sentence: 사진에서 본 분이죠? 네, 우리 선생님이에요.

language_specific.morphology: 분 + 이다 takes -지요 after 이-; 분이죠 uses the shortened form -죠.
language_specific.prosody: Target: Use questioning intonation to check the identification.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker checks whether the person is the one previously seen in a photo.

common.sentence: 회의는 세 시예요. 못 들었는데 다시 말씀해 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 다시 + 말씀해 + 주시겠어요 combines a request to speak again with the polite request form -아/어 주시겠어요.
language_specific.social_context: The listener politely asks for repetition after failing to hear.

common.sentence: 여기에 임시라고 써 있어요. 임시가 무슨 뜻이에요?

language_specific.morphology: 무슨 modifies 뜻; 뜻 + 이다 takes the informal polite ending -이에요.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 뜻이에요 [뜨시에요]. The final consonant of 뜻 links to the following vowel.
language_specific.lexical_frame: N이/가 무슨 뜻이에요?: What does N mean?

common.sentence: 내일 시험이 취소됐어요. 뭐라고요?

language_specific.morphology: 뭐라고요 is an elliptical quotation form used to ask about what was just said.
language_specific.prosody: Target: Use questioning intonation to check the unexpected news.

common.sentence: 회의는 화요일이에요. 아니, 수요일이에요.
common.note: The speaker immediately corrects their own statement.

language_specific.prosody: Target: Mark the correction with a brief pause after 아니.

common.sentence: 세 시가 아니라 네 시예요. 제가 잘못 들었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 잘못 + 듣다: the ㄷ in 듣- changes to ㄹ before -었어요, giving 들었어요.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 잘못 들었어요 [잘몯 뜨러써요]. The initial ㄷ of 들었어요 is tensed after the final consonant of 잘못, and ㄹ links to the following vowel.
language_specific.social_context: The listener acknowledges their own mishearing after a correction.

common.sentence: 계약 내용을 이행해 주세요. 네, 약속대로 하겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 이행하- + -여 contracts to 이행해.
language_specific.social_context: One speaker makes an informal polite request; the other undertakes it formally.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 계약 내용을 이행하다: carry out the terms of a contract.

common.sentence: 이 업무를 수행해 주시겠어요? 네, 맡겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 수행하- + -여 contracts to 수행해.
language_specific.social_context: One speaker makes an informal polite request; the other accepts the task formally.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 업무를 수행하다: carry out a task.

common.sentence: 안전 규칙을 준수해 주세요. 네, 알겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 준수하- + -여 contracts to 준수해.
language_specific.social_context: One speaker requests compliance informally and politely; the other responds formally.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 규칙을 준수하다: comply with rules.

common.sentence: 제출 시간을 엄수해 주세요. 네, 늦지 않겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 엄수하- + -여 contracts to 엄수해.
language_specific.social_context: One speaker makes an informal polite request; the other responds formally.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시간을 엄수하다: strictly observe a time.

common.sentence: 누가 이 일을 책임지나요? 제가 책임지겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: The compound verb stem 책임지- takes -겠- and -습니다.
language_specific.social_context: One speaker asks informally and politely; the other responds formally.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 일을 책임지다: take responsibility for a task.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 책임지겠습니다 [채김지겓씀니다]. The ㄱ of 책 links to 임; final ㅆ of 겠 is realized as ㄷ before tense ㅅ, and ㅂ of 습니다 becomes ㅁ before ㄴ.

common.sentence: 참석할 수 있나요? 아직 확답하기 어려워요.

language_specific.morphology: 확답하- + -기 turns the verb into a nominal form.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 확답하기 어렵다: be unable to give a definite answer easily.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 확답하기 [확따파기]. The ㄷ of 답 is tensed after ㄱ, and its final ㅂ combines with ㅎ to produce ㅍ.

common.sentence: 어제 결정한 내용을 번복하나요? 네, 다시 논의하겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 번복하- takes the question ending -나요.
language_specific.social_context: One speaker asks informally and politely; the other responds formally.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 결정한 내용을 번복하다: reverse what was decided.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 번복하나요 [번보카나요]. The final ㄱ of 복 combines with ㅎ to produce ㅋ.

common.sentence: 주민들이 시에 문제 해결을 촉구했어요. 빨리 해결되면 좋겠어요.

language_specific.morphology: 촉구하- + -였어요 contracts to 촉구했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시에 문제 해결을 촉구하다: urge the city to solve a problem.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 촉구했어요 [촉꾸해써요]. The ㄱ of 구 is tensed after the preceding ㄱ, and the final consonant of 했 links to 어.

common.sentence: 아직 생각 중이에요. 너무 다그치지 마세요.
common.meaning: press someone insistently, before a following prohibition

language_specific.morphology: 다그치- takes -지 before the prohibitive 마세요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 다그치지 마세요: please do not press me insistently.

common.sentence: 아이에게 모르는 사람이 오면 문을 열지 말라고 일러뒀어요. 잘하셨어요.

language_specific.morphology: The single verb 일러두다 has the stem 일러두-; -었어요 contracts with 두- to give 일러뒀어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 아이에게 열지 말라고 일러두다: instruct a child beforehand not to open something.

common.sentence: 날짜가 틀렸네요. 바로잡겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 바로잡- takes -겠- and -습니다.
language_specific.social_context: One speaker points out the error informally and politely; the other responds formally.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 틀린 날짜를 바로잡다: correct an incorrect date.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 바로잡겠습니다 [바로잡껟씀니다]. The ㄱ after 잡 is tense; final ㅆ of 겠 is realized as ㄷ before tense ㅅ, and ㅂ of 습니다 becomes ㅁ before ㄴ.

common.sentence: 두 날짜를 혼동했어요. 다시 확인할게요.

language_specific.morphology: 혼동하- + -였어요 contracts to 혼동했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 두 날짜를 혼동하다: confuse two dates.

common.sentence: 시간이 다르게 전달돼 혼선이 생겼어요. 다시 알려 드릴게요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 혼선이 생기다: confusion or disruption arises.

common.sentence: 메일 주소에 오타가 있네요. 다시 입력할게요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 오타가 있다: there is a typing error.

common.sentence: 인쇄된 이름에 오자가 있어요. 고쳐 주세요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 오자가 있다: there is an incorrect character.

common.sentence: 예약 날짜에 착오가 있었어요. 날짜를 바꿔 드릴게요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 날짜에 착오가 있다: there is a mistake in the date.

common.sentence: 아까 한 말은 말실수였어요. 죄송해요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 말실수이다: be a mistake in what one said.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 말실수 [말실쑤]. The ㅅ of 수 is tense after ㄹ within 실수; the initial ㅅ of 실 remains plain.

common.sentence: 거절할 때 정중하게 말씀해 주세요. 네, 조심할게요.

language_specific.morphology: 정중하- takes -게 to modify 말씀해 주세요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 정중하게 말씀하다: speak respectfully.

common.sentence: 그 말은 너무 직접적이에요. 좀 완곡하게 말해 주세요.

language_specific.morphology: 완곡하- takes -게 to modify 말해 주세요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 완곡하게 말하다: express something tactfully and indirectly.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 완곡하게 [완고카게]. The final ㄱ of 곡 combines with ㅎ to produce ㅋ.

common.sentence: 날짜를 말하지 않아서 답이 모호해요. 날짜를 물어볼게요.

language_specific.morphology: 모호하- + -여요 contracts to 모호해요.

common.sentence: 정말 고마워요. 진심이에요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 진심이다: be sincere in what one says.

common.sentence: 행사가 취소되어 유감이에요. 다음에 꼭 만나요.
common.note: Expressing regret does not by itself admit fault.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 유감이다: feel regret about a situation.

common.sentence: 법정에서 사실만 말하겠다고 맹세했어요. 이제 증언할게요.

language_specific.morphology: 맹세하- + -였어요 contracts to 맹세했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사실만 말하겠다고 맹세하다: swear to tell only the truth.

common.sentence: 새 직원들은 비밀을 지키겠다고 서약했어요. 저도 그랬어요.

language_specific.morphology: 서약하- + -였어요 contracts to 서약했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 비밀을 지키겠다고 서약하다: pledge to keep a secret.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 서약했어요 [서야캐써요]. The final ㄱ of 약 combines with ㅎ to produce ㅋ, and the final consonant of 했 links to 어.

common.sentence: 자료가 부족해서 판단을 유보하겠습니다. 더 살펴보겠습니다.
common.meaning: I will withhold it for now.

language_specific.morphology: 유보하- takes -겠- and -습니다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 판단을 유보하다: reserve judgment.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 유보하겠습니다 [유보하겓씀니다]. Final ㅆ of 겠 is realized as ㄷ before tense ㅅ, and ㅂ of 습니다 becomes ㅁ before ㄴ.

common.sentence: 계약서의 이 조항을 확인해 주세요. 네, 읽어 볼게요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 계약서의 조항: a clause in a contract.
